topic: Pig butchering crypto investment scam vs spotting it early (Devon vs Priya)

scenes.narration: A wrong number text became a ninety thousand dollar crypto investment scam. Case file 0061. Time of incident, late evening. Let me open the evidence.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office studying a phone with a stranger's text and a fake crypto chart, comic burst banner reads CASE FILE 0061, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Devon and Priya each get a friendly wrong number text from a stranger.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man devon and woman priya each looking at a phone showing a polite WRONG NUMBER message from a stranger, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The stranger is warm, chats for weeks, and never asks for money yet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a friendly stranger avatar chatting daily on a phone screen, a calendar showing WEEKS OF MESSAGES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eventually they mention a crypto platform with guaranteed daily returns.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a slick fake crypto app on a phone with a banner reading GUARANTEED DAILY RETURNS, glowing green arrows, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Devon invests five thousand and watches the dashboard climb fast.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man devon grinning at a phone showing a fake balance jumping up, a stack labeled FIVE THOUSAND beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The fake profits hook him to wire ninety thousand more in savings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man devon wiring a large transfer, a screen reads SENDING NINETY THOUSAND, his savings jar emptying, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya searches the platform and finds no real company behind it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya at a laptop, search results show NO COMPANY FOUND and NO LICENSE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She spots the rule, real investments never guarantee daily profit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya holding a notepad reading NO GUARANTEED RETURNS, calm and confident, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Devon tries to withdraw and is told to pay a tax first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man devon staring at a phone popup demanding PAY TAX TO WITHDRAW, his face falling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That fee is the final trap, his ninety thousand is gone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an empty crypto wallet on a phone stamped FUNDS GONE, devastated man devon holding his head, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya blocks the number and reports the wallet to investigators.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya tapping BLOCK on a phone and filing a report stamped REPORTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A stranger plus crypto plus guaranteed returns equals a scam. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash stamping a file CASE CLOSED in his noir office, a board reads NO GUARANTEED RETURNS, kids comic book illustration
